full_sentence: How the committee will respond remains an open question.

options.why_wrong: This is a finished clause that does not function as a predicate for the nominal clause 'how the committee will respond'.
The nominal clause is singular and takes a singular verb, so the plural 'remain' does not agree.
An infinitive cannot serve as the main verb of the sentence, so the clause is incomplete.

grammar_focus: Nominal 'how' clauses as subjects with singular verb agreement
explanation: A nominal 'how' clause used as the subject takes a singular verb, so the main verb must be singular to agree with the whole clause.
translation: How the committee will respond remains an open question.
